get.description: SSE named change; cursor is process epoch and sequence. Replays at most 64 events from a log of 1000 events/10 minutes; older cursors receive reset. Five-second heartbeats, 120-second connection lifetime, max 64 streams. Revocation closes existing streams. Events contain metadata only, not note bodies or credentials.

get.summary: Inspect a managed image before decoding
get.description: Authenticated. PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF only, at most 20 MiB and 40 megapixels. Returns dimensions/animation status without paths.

400.description: Unsupported format or image limits exceeded

get.summary: Authenticated bounded first-frame PNG for image clipboard copying

200.description: Original bounded image rendered as a first-frame PNG; original file remains unchanged

collectionId.description: Optional existing collection; initial membership commits with resource creation. Used only on create.

revision.description: Opaque server revision. Send as a quoted If-Match validator on note updates; never infer ordering.

exactMatch.description: Whether any collection name exactly matches the trimmed query, ignoring case, independent of pagination.

kind.description: collection for organizational shortcuts; otherwise the resource type.

count.description: Resource count for a collection; zero for resources.

resource.description: Batch-enriched resource metadata; null for collection shortcuts. No note body.

appliedKind.description: Confirms server-side shortcut filtering. all when no kind was requested.

highlights.description: Half-open UTF-16 offsets into text. Render as text, never HTML.

SettingsPatch.description: Atomic recursive settings leaf patch. Omitted leaves are unchanged; null resets/removes a leaf. Up to 64 KiB, depth four. Same-leaf simultaneous edits are last committed write wins.

OwnerKey.name: X-Vaultor-Owner
OwnerKey.description: Main-process or provisioned local owner credential. Loopback connector only; never renderer storage or URLs.

DeviceCredential.description: Host-approved 32-byte hex credential over shared HTTPS; owner endpoints excluded.

BrowserOwner.name: VaultorOwner
BrowserOwner.description: Loopback HttpOnly SameSite=Strict owner browser session. Mutations require X-Vaultor-CSRF.

BrowserClient.name: __Host-VaultorClient
BrowserClient.description: HTTPS Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict device session. Mutations require X-Vaultor-CSRF.
